Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1216
Claimant:
Toni Richardson
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
4 Mar 2023
Claim opened after the insured reported being rear-ended at a stop. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all
further contact will go through the attorney's office.
9 Mar 2023
Spoke with the driver named on the policy, who confirmed the vehicle and coverage details. The driver's account of
the collision matches the report received at intake.
13 Mar 2023
Obtained the police report and statements from two independent witnesses. Both describe the other vehicle stopping
abruptly and both confirm the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time.
13 May 2023
Reviewed the photographs from the scene and the other driver's statement. Both are consistent with the described
impact, and the other driver confirms the accident happened as reported.
7 Jun 2023
Inspected the vehicle. The damage is mostly in line with the described impact, and a few old scratches near the
bumper may predate this crash and have been noted separately.
11 Jun 2023
Received the claimant's initial injury report through counsel, describing a back strain. The reported injury is plausible
for a collision of this type, and no prior injury to the same body area is known to us.
20 Jun 2023
Took a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The account of the collision was the same as the one
given at intake and in the earlier call with the claimant's office.
23 Jun 2023
Reviewed the medical records as they came in. Treatment has increased to many times the usual amount for this
injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added several weeks after the crash.
19 Aug 2023
Requested further records and an independent medical review to address the rise in treatment frequency and the
new body areas. The review is pending and will be weighed against the earlier findings.
29 Aug 2023
Cehcked the policy history. Nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before the coverage began, and the
coverage was in force at the time of loss.
1 Sep 2023
Claim remains open pending the independent medical review and the attorney's response to the treatment questions.
Reserves reviewed and will be updated once the review is received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
